name: wealth
description: 12 tools covering NPV, IRR, EMV, market data, institutional stress, governance, and capital wisdom. Computes, never allocates.

scenarios.description: Agent computes NPV from cash flows. Must match analytical solution within tolerance.
scenarios.prompt: Compute the Net Present Value (NPV) for this investment: initial cost $100, followed by annual returns of $30, $40, $50, $60 over 4 years. Discount rate = 10%.

scenarios.description: Agent computes Expected Monetary Value for a drilling decision.
scenarios.prompt: A wildcat well costs $50M to drill. Probability of success is 25%. If successful, the field is worth $300M. If dry, worth $0. Compute the Expected Monetary Value (EMV).

scenarios.description: Agent evaluates a proposal through the capital wisdom lens. Must address dignity, sovereignty, resilience, optionality.
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate this proposal using capital_wisdom: 'Invest $10M to automate 200 jobs in a small Malaysian town to cut costs by $2M/year.'
